mechanism: Loperamide may delay gastrointestinal transit and reduce gentamicin absorption; gentamicin's nephrotoxicity could be compounded in patients with reduced renal clearance secondary to loperamide-induced fluid retention.
action: Monitor renal function and gentamicin levels closely; separate administration timing if possible and ensure adequate hydration; avoid loperamide if diarrhea is infectious in origin being treated with gentamicin.
